details: Oracle Coherence Cache – Bermuda Platform
In-memory data grid system to host legal publishing metadata (LPA, Topic & Key), designed for high scalability and fault tolerance using multicast communication.
Implemented Oracle Coherence for distributed caching with focus on performance and node availability.
Optimized communication between clustered nodes using multicast addressing for fault tolerance.
Environment: Java, Oracle Coherence, Gradle.
